subject_lines: Four jobs for one recycled panel
Washstands from fridge plastic, plus three more jobs
Hotel washstands from plastic that once lined fridges
preview_text: Plinths in Amsterdam, washstands in Vienna, worktops in Paris, furniture in Taipei
headline: One recycled panel, four different jobs
intro:
Polygood® is a panel made from recycled plastic. In the four projects below it became display plinths in an Amsterdam department store, washstands in a Vienna hotel, kitchenette worktops in a Paris office and furniture in a Taipei design studio.

One pattern, Emerald Ghost, appears in three of them: on the hotel's washstands, on the office worktops and among the studio's pieces.

cases.title: De Bijenkorf
cases.body:
De Bijenkorf reopened the women's fashion and shoe department of its Dam Square flagship in 2026. Random Studio, working with the store's own design team, ran a lifecycle assessment workshop before choosing what to build with. The store first used Polygood in 2023 and chose it again. We made the display stands in Salmon Terra, stepped plinths and blocks built by Fiction Factory.

Each panel is pressed from one type of recycled plastic, so when the displays change, the stands can come back through our take-back programme and become new panels.
cases.application: Display stands: stepped plinths and blocks

cases.title: Henriette Stadthotel
cases.body:
In 2025 Verena Brandtner-Pastuszyn and Georg Pastuszyn renovated their family-run four-star hotel near the Prater as what they call Austria's first Circular Living hotel. The concept, inspired by Cradle to Cradle, weighs every material on its health, recyclability and carbon, and on its social and biodiversity impact.

For the new Circular Living rooms we made the bathroom washstands in Sapphire Terrazzo, Emerald Ghost and White Terrazzo, from plastic that once lined fridges and freezers.
cases.pattern: Sapphire Terrazzo, Emerald Ghost, White Terrazzo
cases.application: Bathroom washstands for the Circular Living rooms

cases.title: Orion
cases.body: Aura designed the teal kitchenette where Orion's Paris team meets through the day. A white stone or wood top would have cut a line through the teal. We made the worktops on the island and back counter in Emerald Ghost, a flecked sea green a shade lighter than the cabinets, so the island and counters read as one block of colour. Samji Studio, which builds office furniture from recycled materials, cut the island top to follow its rounded end.

cases.title: ONE DUST Studio
cases.body:
For our first project in Taiwan we worked with ONE DUST, a Taipei design studio that makes installation art and decorative finishes, including mineral wall coatings. Surfaces are its trade, so Polygood was a natural material to test. The studio designed and made tables, chairs, benches, shelves and sculptural objects in five patterns: Maldives, Black Lollipop, Emerald Ghost, Sapphire Terrazzo and Translucent Glitter Gold. It is the only project so far to use Translucent Glitter Gold.

Outside, a translucent blue slab stands among rocks in a gravel garden backed by forest.
cases.pattern: Maldives, Black Lollipop, Emerald Ghost, Sapphire Terrazzo, Translucent Glitter Gold
cases.application: Tables, chairs, benches, shelves and decorative objects

closing: Between them, these four projects use seven Polygood patterns. If one of them suits something you are working on, we can send you a sample.
